critical_code_review_comments: Geocoder fallback: when window.google.maps.Geocoder reverse lookup fails or is throttled, the pickup field falls back to 'lat, lng' string. Functional (input is non-empty) but UX would benefit from a retry or a brief loader indicator; consider catching the failure and retrying after a 1s delay before showing raw coords.

Mode chip concatenates label + secondary description without a visible separator ('Taxi VTCCourse standard' in textContent). Visually fine in screenshots but a separator span between them would help screen-reader output.

Pending screen route summary still shows raw 'lat, lng' string (e.g. '48.85840, 2.29450') for the pickup address when geocoder fallback was used. Consider passing the resolved/intended address to the ride creation payload rather than the coord string.
seed_data_creation: Created one live ride ride_0dfe552214a1 via standard 'Commander' flow as part of assertion 3 (pending screen). Title temporarily changed to 'Réservez votre course' then restored to 'Planifiez votre trajet'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 booking-flow UI changes verified end-to-end: white compact header with admin-editable title (booking_header_title / booking_header_eyebrow), geolocation auto-fill of pickup (Geocoder fallback to lat/lng if reverse lookup intermittent), pending search screen + cancelled screen both on white bg with orange accents (no more blue night), /course?mode=book_later auto-opens schedule calendar pre-set to now+1h, and panel-schedule-toggle opens the calendar directly. Mobile viewport 430x900. Login via /login/email direct route (skips mobile 2-step). Geolocation MUST be granted before navigation: context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=...) + context.set_geolocation({latitude, longitude}).
